title: Choose the visual world for Margareth's OJT Tracker
question: The roll assigned Architectural Field Logbook & Calibrated Cradle. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Architectural Field Logbook & Calibrated Cradle
options.lineage: Engineering field logs & calibrated studio wall schedules
options.thesis: A drafting-table chronometer where every workday is a calibrated 8.8-hour capacity bar seated in a four-month architectural cradle alongside a live mathematical proof rail.
options.viewport: Split precision workbench: left mathematical proof ledger (364.2h rendered / 115.8h remaining / Nov 16 8:24 AM finish), right 4-month tactile Calendar Cradle (Aug–Nov 2026) with proportional fill bars per day.
options.risk: Can feel overly technical if day-slot interactions are not warm and immediate.

raised.raise: Strict tabular numeric alignment across every hour, deduction, and minute calculation.
A continuous trajectory line links Aug 24 through Oct 26 (today's marker) to the exact Nov 16 8:24 AM completion cell.
Each day slot in the cradle features a proportional fill strip encoding 8.8h, 7.2h, 5.0h, or 0.0h without visual clutter.
Rendered days through Oct 26 carry a distinct stamped state separating history from the 14 remaining workdays.

options.label: Bundy Punch-Card Rack & Split-Flap Chronometer
options.lineage: Factory time-clocks, manila punch cards, and mechanical split-flap displays
options.thesis: Every workday sits as a physical timecard in a slotted wall cradle, stamped in navy for full 8.8h shifts and crimson ribbon ink for undertime and absences.
options.viewport: Mechanical split-flap countdown header above a physical 4-month card rack where clicking any slot pulls out the day's timecard to edit clock-in/out.
options.risk: Familiar time-tracker metaphor that most skeuomorphic runs gravitate toward.

options.label: Boarding Pass & Live Gate Sequence Board
options.lineage: Vernacular travel documents and mechanical departure boards
options.thesis: Pairs a perforated OJT Clearance Pass at the top with a live sequence board that reflows the completion gate whenever a shift or holiday changes.
options.viewport: Segmented OJT Boarding Pass (Origin: Aug 24 -> Destination: Nov 16 08:24 AM) over a 60-workday sequence board with amber alerts on shortened days.
options.case: Fuses cleanly: OJT completion is a journey toward a moving arrival gate, and attendance edits visibly shift the arrival row.
options.risk: Day-by-day calendar scanning must stay calendar-shaped rather than purely a vertical flight list.

options.label: Centre-Rail Reference Edition
options.lineage: Wide-margin reference editions with a vermilion centre key rail
options.thesis: Twins the mathematical proof column and the calendar cradle around a live vermilion centre rail that brackets every absence, early out, and holiday back to the exact formula line.
options.viewport: Two structured columns bridged by an SVG ruling engine that draws live vermilion brackets between the deduction math on the left and the exact calendar dates on the right.
options.case: Holds product clarity strongly because the user explicitly asked for both the computing process and the calendar cradle side-by-side.
options.risk: Three-value palette requires carefully differentiated fill patterns for half-day vs. early-out cells.

options.label: Datamatics Barcode Field
options.lineage: Ryoji Ikeda pure black-and-white data-sublime lattices
options.thesis: Every OJT hour rendered as a high-contrast monochrome barcode column and sine wave.
options.viewport: 60 vertical barcode slices representing workdays with dense numeric margins.
options.case: Loses on both axes: pure black-and-white strobing barcodes obscure multi-state attendance editing.
options.kept: Strict tabular numeric alignment across every hour, deduction, and minute calculation.

options.label: ISO Orienteering Course Map
options.lineage: ISOM topographic orienteering maps and control description tables
options.thesis: The 480-hour requirement plotted as a purple orienteering course across four monthly terrain contours.
options.viewport: Contour map ground with numbered purple control circles for each milestone week.
options.case: Terrain topography distracts from weekday calendar scanning.
options.kept: A continuous trajectory line linking Aug 24 through Oct 26 to the Nov 16 finish cell.

options.label: Factory Catalog Color-Code Sleeve
options.lineage: Peter Saville Factory Records catalog system and coded color blocks
options.thesis: Matte black ground where every OJT week is a pulsar line and attendance states are encoded as minimalist color strips.
options.viewport: FAC-480 headline above a stacked pulsar plot of weekly hours and coded color strips.
options.case: Hiding labels behind hover-decoded color blocks slows down daily time-tracking.
options.kept: Proportional color-coded fill strips inside each day cell.

options.label: Convention Hall Stamp Grid
options.lineage: Newsprint convention catalogs with hand-circled biro routes
options.thesis: A dense newsprint grid of 65 workday stamps where completed shifts are struck through by hand in red biro.
options.viewport: Numbered stamp grid with hand-drawn checkmarks through Oct 26 and a circled finish target on Nov 16.
options.case: Postage-stamp density is built for 800 booths rather than 65 rich daily logs.
options.kept: Distinct hand-marked state separating completed days through Oct 26 from future days.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: Clean modern SaaS productivity dashboard and calendar grid executed at high craft.
canonCard.viewport: Top KPI summary row above a two-column layout with attendance breakdown and interactive monthly calendar.
